policy: The current camera recommendation catalog covers cameras a person directly operates handheld, on a tripod, or in a camera rig, where body or fixed-lens choice and ordinary size, weight, viewing, power and lens-system comparisons inform a purchase. Remotely operated robotic/PTZ installation systems require a separate decision model and are deferred, even if they use an interchangeable mount or appear in a Sony consumer gallery.

entries.reason: A remotely operated pan/tilt/zoom full-frame production camera intended for networked or installed operation. Its controller, installation, power, and remote-operation choices are central to purchase decisions; ordinary handheld camera body/weight/viewfinder comparisons do not represent that system.
entries.reconsideration: Reassess when the service offers a professional remote/PTZ purchase flow with control, installation, network, power and system-cost comparisons; review Sony's then-current identity and specifications before ingestion.

entries.reason: Restricted infrared/spectral camera: official Korean page limits buyers to specified scientific, forensic and cultural-preservation institutions and requires a buyer agreement. Spectral filters, purchase eligibility and specialized workflow are not ordinary visible-light body comparisons.
entries.reconsideration: Reassess when restricted spectral-camera purchase/filter workflows can be represented. Do not alias to the visible-light GFX100 II.

entries.reason: Analog film and hybrid printing/consumable workflows need adjacent purchase criteria; Pal is digital, not analog, and requires separate phone/printing workflow assessment.
entries.reconsideration: Reassess as a specialty/adjacent category when instant film format, consumable cost, print workflow and hybrid/phone connectivity can be compared. Evaluate digital Pal separately from analog cameras; recheck then-current individual identity and availability before ingestion. Not a permanent exclusion.

entries.reason: Ten retained Korean official PTZ cards center on motorized remote pan/tilt, installation and network/live output; separate from the directly-operated 49-card / 39-identity denominator. Professional status alone is not the criterion. Deferred candidates, not permanent exclusions.
entries.reconsideration: Re-evaluate individual then-current identities in a specialty scope phase with controller/installation/network/live-output requirements; no automatic canonical exclusion or mapping to handheld bodies.

entries.reason: Five retained Korean studio/multipurpose heads center on live SDI/IP, return/intercom, CCU or ROP/system and external capture configuration. Several support CCU-less operation; no blanket CCU requirement or professional/B4 exclusion. Review standalone/shoulder/rig eligibility per model.
entries.reconsideration: Re-evaluate each standalone/shoulder/rig/box acquisition workflow, external recording/power/lens requirements and delivered versus licensed/optional CCU/IP features in a separate specialty session; directly-operated models may move into general coverage after explicit review.

modelReviews.standaloneOperation: Official camera-head 12G-SDI and IP workflows can operate without a CCU; do not mark CCU mandatory. Future firmware capabilities remain conditional.
modelReviews.reason: Live camera-head acquisition with return/intercom, SDI/IP and ROP/system integration, rather than an assumed self-contained recording body.
modelReviews.reconsideration: Review standalone camera-head or shoulder operation with external recorder/power and lens, as well as delivered firmware, before deciding specialty versus general directly-operated ingestion.

modelReviews.standaloneOperation: Multipurpose box camera supports robot, gimbal, crane and ceiling/rig mounting; CCU necessity is not established and must not be presumed.
modelReviews.reason: Box/system acquisition integrating remote control, LAN/tally and output-based live capture. Handheld/rig use remains an individual scope candidate.
modelReviews.reconsideration: Review manual/rig/gimbal operation, external recording and power requirements independently; directly-operated purchase flow could justify later general coverage.

modelReviews.standaloneOperation: Camera-head 12G-SDI and ST 2110 operation without CCU is explicitly supported; PL lens and Super35 live cinema workflow are distinct from B4 studio cameras.
modelReviews.reason: Live cinematic system head, return/intercom and external SDI/IP capture. Professional status or PL mount is not an exclusion reason.
modelReviews.reconsideration: Review standalone PL cinema/rig workflow and external recorder/power configuration individually, alongside live-system dependencies and delivered features.

modelReviews.standaloneOperation: Camera-head HD-SDI output supports 1080p/1080i/720p; CCU enables optical transmission and broader system operation. Do not infer standalone UHD from CCU/system specifications.
modelReviews.reason: Studio camera head with optical CCU, return and ROP integration; standalone HD output does not make every system specification a body recording specification.
modelReviews.reconsideration: Assess shoulder/standalone HD acquisition with external recorder, power and viewfinder, and distinguish CCU UHD operation before scope/field ingestion.

modelReviews.standaloneOperation: Camera-head HD-SDI output exists. Paid AK-SFC391 enables CCU-less ST 2110 HD; optional 4K upgrade is a separate system condition, not unconditional camera-head 4K.
modelReviews.reason: Studio/system live camera head with CCU or licensed IP return/intercom and external capture; shoulder operation alone is not sufficient to declare the purchasing configuration self-contained.
modelReviews.reconsideration: Review standalone HD shoulder workflow and paid CCU-less IP configuration separately from optional CCU/4K upgrades and external recorder/power requirements.

entries.reason: IR-cut filter physically tuned for nearly100% H-alpha transmission; manufacturer explicitly discourages ordinary subjects due red-biased output. Independent specialty identity, not an alias of visible-light base camera; dedicated spectral/filter workflow review needed.
entries.reconsideration: Pilot spectral/H-alpha and daylight-filter workflow without aliasing to visible-light base. Review feature contract separately before production.
